name: cavalry
description: A growing collection of Cavalry Collective skills for Claude Code, invoked as /cavalry:<skill>. Currently: init (start a project from the Cavalry template with a visual stack + add-on chooser), user-story-map (interactive drag-and-drop story mapping), wireframe (build a UI wireframe and comment directly on it), and phase-wireframe (cut one mockup into a mockup per release phase, subtraction only). The interactive ones link the open page back to the Claude session, so edits and feedback return without copy-paste.
